hooks.description: tdd-guard: block Edit/Write on production files when no failing test is scoped. Blocks test deletion. Blocks over-implementation. Install once: pnpm dlx tdd-guard@latest install
pr-base-guard: block `gh pr create` against a non-main base (merge should = deploy to prod). Override an intentional stacked PR with a trailing `# stacked`.
merged-branch-guard: block `git push` to a branch whose PR already merged (commits would be silently orphaned). Override with a trailing `# allow-merged-push`.

migration-number-guard: refuse a migration version already taken on ANY remote branch, and name the next free one. Two files sharing a version breaks `supabase start`, which reddens every database job on every branch.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ]; then case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) pnpm prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -3 ;; esac; fi

hooks.description: typecheck-on-turn: run `pnpm typecheck` ONCE at turn end, only when the turn changed TS/JS. Replaces the per-edit PostToolUse typecheck that re-ran tsc over the whole project after every Edit/Write.
JIT: inject the top project learnings into context at session start so they actually get re-read. Append lessons with .claude/hooks/learnings.sh log.
